games.name: Papers Please
games.desc: Work as a border inspector in the fictional communist country of Arstotzka. Review documents and decide who may enter while navigating political pressure and moral dilemmas.

games.name: Spore
games.desc: Evolve a species from a microscopic cell to a space-faring civilization. Five distinct gameplay stages combine simulation, strategy and role-playing with extensive procedural generation.

games.name: Balatro
games.desc: A poker-themed roguelike deck-builder built around powerful synergies. Exploit Jokers and Tarot cards to break the game's own rules and reach impossible score targets.

games.name: Plants vs. Zombies
games.desc: Defend your home from a zombie apocalypse by strategically placing plants with unique abilities. A timeless classic that defined the tower defense genre for a generation.

games.name: Age of History II
games.desc: A compact but highly replayable grand strategy experience. It focuses on map control, diplomacy, and expansion with a clean design that rewards long-term planning.

games.name: Rimworld
games.desc: A sci-fi colony management simulator and story generator developed by Ludeon Studios. You guide a few crash-landed survivors on a distant, lawless planet as they build a base, manage their mental and physical health, fight raiders, and try to escape.

games.name: Mini Motorways
games.desc: A minimalist strategy and puzzle video game where players draw road networks to manage traffic in a growing city. Created by Dinosaur Polo Club (the developers of Mini Metro), the game challenges you to connect color-coded homes and destinations while preventing traffic jams.
